thread:
Mira (Product): Quick sync — finalizing console observability roadmap for Q3. Customers keep asking for: (A) route-level cost breakdown, (B) low-overhead tracing hooks, (C) error analytics with example payloads. I sketched an MVP and need engineering feasibility + launch criteria. Can we align? TL;DR below.

Alex P (Eng-runtime): Sounds good. Quick feasibility notes: route cost = straightforward once we tag requests by route/model; tracing hooks need careful sampler defaults to avoid ingestion spike; error analytics is mostly log/telemetry processing + grouping. Rough estimate: cost breakdown 3 wks, tracing hooks 4–6 wks (incl. sampler + infra), error analytics 3–4 wks if we reuse existing grouping pipelines.

Samir (Eng-SRE): We need retention/ingest budget before committing. Traces increase cardinality. If we enable full traces by default we add ~x3 storage. Proposal: default sampling 1% with per-customer override and a temporary on-demand capture mode for incidents. Also add a quota/alert if daily spans > expected.

Zoe (Design): I can produce compact dashboard mocks by EOW. For acceptance we need clarity on widgets: cost breakdown (bar by route, heatmap by model), trace link (trace id -> flamegraph), error insights (top errors, sample inputs, occurrence trend). Any constraints on width/placement for embedding in existing console?

Kevin (Data): Schema note: add tags: org_id, route_id, model_variant, user_tier, request_size_tokens, inference_latency_ms. Cost attribution needs token counts + per-model unit cost. If we publish per-route cost we must also backfill last 30 days for customers in beta. Backfill will be heavy but doable via batch job.

Mira (Product): Priorities for launch: 1) cost breakdown per-route (customers asked for immediate visibility) 2) tracing hooks with safe defaults 3) error analytics (grouping + example snippets). Launch criteria proposal: a) accurate per-route cost with <5% variance vs billing for sampled routes, b) trace capture without >20% increase in p99 latency on inference path, c) error analytics surfaces top-5 errors with sample inputs and has basic dedupe. Canary plan: beta to 3 customers + internal teams, feature flag gated.

Alex P (Eng-runtime): On the perf criterion: I suggest enforcing async trace ingestion and prioritizing KV-cache path — synchronous hooks will be a non-starter. For sampling config we can support dynamic rules: by route, by customer, by latency (capture traces where latency > threshold). Example config: ```json
{"default_rate": 0.01, "overrides": [{"route": "chat-complete", "rate": 0.05}, {"latency_ms_gt": 500, "rate": 1.0}]}```

Samir (Eng-SRE): Ops requirements: A) quota windows and autoscale targets for trace consumers, B) retention tiers (7/30/90 days) selectable per org, C) alerting on sudden increases in error rate or trace volume. We'll need an estimate of expected spans/day for the canary customers to size infra.

Zoe (Design): Mock checklist: which dimensions for the cost bar are must-have? (model_variant, route, time window). I assume token-based cost is primary. Also UX ask: enable drilldown from cost item to related traces/errors.

Kevin (Data): Confirming token-based cost + overhead ops (GPU hours). For the initial surface we can show token-driven cost with an "est. infra" overlay. Backfill note: if customer opts-in to backfill, we queue a batch recompute; warn about delay.

Mira (Product): OK actionable items: Alex/Samir to produce rough ETA + blockers by EOD tomorrow, Kevin to publish proposed metric schema, Zoe to drop mock links, I'll file a beta invite ticket and draft launch criteria doc. Can we also include an acceptance checklist: docs, SDK hooks, telemetry tests, and billing reconciliation.

Alex P (Eng-runtime): I'll post a short RFC with tradeoffs — will include perf targets and a plan for async ingestion + sampling rules. Expect first pass by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:

Samir (Eng-SRE): I'll run a cost projection based on 3 representative customers and propose retention defaults.

ops-bot: Ticket #PROD-9876 created: "Observe: Console cost & tracing MVP" — https://redwood.example/ticket/PROD-9876

Mira (Product): Thanks all. If nobody objects, I'll lock priorities and share the launch criteria doc for review.

Alex P (Eng-runtime): No objections from me.

Zoe (Design): SGTM

Kevin (Data): SGTM

Samir (Eng-SRE): SGTM

Mira (Product): Marking this thread resolved for now — we'll reconvene after RFCs and mocks land. :white_check_mark:
